channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Keldon Johnson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Keldon Johnson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Keldon Johnson
item.description:
Victor Wembanyama:

“Devin’s increasing leadership role coincides with our increase as a contender. He embodies our progress and with Keldon, they are the oldest Spurs here. They know it. They know the power they got on this. They know how much they can make us better and they do it very well and very intelligently.”

Victor Wembanyama on Keldon Johnson, Oct 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on Keldon Johnson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Mitch Johnson on the Spurs having not one but two 82-game Iron Men in Julian Champagnie (2nd year in a row) and Keldon Johnson:

“To have those consistent puzzle pieces is a huge part of why we are where we are.… Those guys have shown up to work every single night …”

Mitch Johnson on Keldon Johnson, Apr 12, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Dylan Harper on Keldon Johnson
item.description:
“But as the season kept going on, the second group got to come in with me — KJ [Keldon Johnson], Luke [Kornet] — we kind of have our own little group and we get to go and play basketball. So, it’s definitely a challenge and different. But what’s so scary is that the first lineup is so good and the second lineup is just as good.”

Dylan Harper on Keldon Johnson, Apr 1, 2026. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Stephon Castle on Keldon Johnson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Castle on Keldon:

“That’s a constant thing for Keldon, the energy he brings. It just uplifts everybody, the crowd, the team. The other team can feel the energy in the arena when he checks in. It’s just a boost all around the court.”

Stephon Castle on Keldon Johnson, Jan 8, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Keldon:

“He has taken defense more seriously than he ever has and he understands that nothing's going to happen success-wise unless we concentrate on the defense.”

Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson, Oct 21, 2023. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson
item.description:
“Keldon always plays hard. He always plays with emotion. I thought he held the ball less, caught it and pulled it and attacked the rim without any hesitation especially in the first half. He did that great.”

Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson, Dec 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @RealTomPetrini.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson, Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
More from Pop on Sochan:

“He’s got a lot of personality like Keldon Johnson does. And he is aggressive. I think it’s a good opportunity for him to play with those guys and see how he handles things when the lights go on, so to speak.”

Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson, Jeremy Sochan, Oct 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson, Derrick White
item.description:
More from Pop on D White's impact:

“He and Jakob and DJ, night after night, after night are giving us (confident play) right now. When you add Keldon (Johnson) into that group, it's been pretty”

Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson, Derrick White, Dec 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson
item.description:
Pop on Keldon's defensive growth:

“Just basically starting from scratch in understanding about the other people in the league more than anything. Understanding the talent they have, what their tendencies are, how to stay in front of people and, of course, learning team defense.”

Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson, May 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Keldon Johnson's selection to Rising Stars roster:

“It means a lot to Keldon. I’m happy as hell for him. He deserves it. It really makes him feel good that his efforts have been applauded and rewarded and noticed, so that’s great.”

Gregg Popovich on Keldon Johnson, Mar 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Jakob Poeltl on Derrick White, Keldon Johnson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Poeltl on keeping in touch with teammates in protocols:

“Most of them are pretty bored in quarantine. Derrick was talking to a bunch of us in pregame yesterday, and I was texting Keldon the other day asking how he was doing. Obviously, there are still ways to communicate.”

Jakob Poeltl on Derrick White, Keldon Johnson, Feb 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Patty Mills on Keldon Johnson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Patty Mills on Keldon Johnson defending so many bigger guys, including LeBron:

“He’s young, he’s strong, he’s tough – really tough– and definitely up for the task. It's been a good measuring stick for him early in the season.”

Patty Mills on Keldon Johnson, Jan 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Rudy Gay on Keldon Johnson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Rudy Gay on Keldon Johnson saying he packed on about 7-8 pounds of muscle after bubble:

“He still tries to bully me, and that’s not going to happen... Hopefully it works with other people.”

Rudy Gay on Keldon Johnson, Dec 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Rudy Gay on Keldon Johnson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Rudy Gay on Keldon Johnson, who is expected to return tonight after missing the preseason with a foot injury:

“He’s our spark. He has unlimited energy and he brings it every day, and that’s something we need... He is dedicated. He really wants to be great.”

Rudy Gay on Keldon Johnson, Dec 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
